task.ques: Find the Market Data section on BBC News and tell me which company the data comes from.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The company was Morningstar. Press Gazette’s 6 December 2024 report states, “The BBC’s data feed was licensed from investment research firm Morningstar.” Evidence: https://pressgazette.co.uk/news/bbc-market-data-news/ and final.png.

BBC’s Market Data section now says its market data feeds have been discontinued: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgl0zprpjeo.
